about: The club's own updates, from its Instagram (@pontardawerfc) and Facebook posts, July to October 2026. updates.summary: Bring the family for a spectacular night at the club. Gates 6pm, fireworks 7:30pm. £5 adults, £3 children, £15 for a family of four.
paragraphs: Fireworks Night at Pontardawe RFC! Bring the family for a spectacular night on Thursday 5 November.
Gates open at 6pm and the fireworks start at 7:30pm. Food and drinks, sweet treats, and family friendly.
Entry: £5 per adult, £3 per child (under 16), or £15 for a family of four (two adults and two children). A night to remember, and a great way to support your local club.

updates.title: Oktoberfest at Pontardawe RFC
updates.summary: Great beer, live music and good times: Jono, John Jones, Double or Nothing and Helix and the Hounds, with Little Goat Brewery, Wok Stix and Nellie May's.
paragraphs: Oktoberfest came to Pontardawe RFC on Saturday 3 October, with live music from 4pm until 11pm and £3 entry.
The line-up: Jono at 4pm, John Jones (live entertainment) from 5:30 to 6:30pm, Double or Nothing at 7pm and Helix and the Hounds at 9pm.
Little Goat Brewery came along, with food from Wok Stix (Asian-inspired noodles) and Nellie May's Fish & Chip Co. Best dress won a £50 bar tab: lederhosen were encouraged!
Thank you to everyone who came. Great beer, live music, good times.

updates.title: Medium Nights at the club
updates.summary: An evening of insight, guidance and good company on the first Monday of the month. 7pm start, £5 entry, cash only. Next: Monday 2 November.
paragraphs: Medium Night at Pontardawe RFC: join us for an evening of insight, guidance and good company. Open minds, open hearts, all welcome.
7pm start, £5 entry (cash only). October's medium was Rodney Frost (Monday 5 October). Earlier this year the club welcomed Pat Howells (3 August) and Jackie Rickard and Helen Jones (7 September).

Our Medium Night on 3 August raised £334, split equally: £167 to our Daffs team fundraising for the Touched by Cancer tournament fundraiser, and £167 to LATCH, the charity raising funds to support children and young people with cancer in Wales. Thank you to everyone who attended and donated.
The next Medium Night is on Monday 2 November.

updates.title: Ponty Fest: Pontardawe Music Festival 2026
updates.summary: Four days of free live music, food and family fun at the club, 13 to 16 August, with Kidsfest and headliners Smooth Operator and Polar Berries.
paragraphs: Ponty Fest 2026, the Pontardawe Music Festival, brought the Swansea Valley community together at the club for four days of live music, food and gratitude from Thursday 13 to Sunday 16 August. Free entry.

Thursday was Kidsfest: from midday, stalls, trampolines, food, sweets, ice cream, a character visit and music, with Mad Jay's kids' entertainment from 1pm to 5pm and Dick Daztardly live at 6pm. Bring a picnic blanket and enjoy!

Friday: Jono at 7pm and Double or Nothing at 9pm. Saturday: Woolfey (12pm), Jonesy (2pm), Rodeo & the Juliets (4pm), Zac and the New Men (7pm) and headliners Smooth Operator at 9pm. Sunday: Lisa J Lewis (12pm), This River (2pm), The Stray Pursuit (4pm), Everything's Electric (7pm) and headliners Polar Berries at 9pm.

Food came from local vendors: loaded nachos, smokin' good BBQ, Aroy Dee Thai food and The Chunky Chip Co. Thank you for supporting local, and to every family who helped make it a safe, fun weekend for everyone.

updates.title: Cwmtawe Sevens vets' touch rugby tournament
updates.summary: Two Pontardawe squads, Ponty Old Boys and the Cherry & Whites, at the Cwmtawe Sevens on Saturday 1 August, with 24 men's and 8 women's teams.
paragraphs: The Cwmtawe Seven's vets' touch rugby tournament was on Saturday 1 August 2026, with fantastic news: for the first time a women's competition, with 8 teams, alongside 24 teams in the men's competition. Both are made up of a main shield, plate and bowl.
Pontardawe sent two men's squads: Ponty Old Boys (team manager Zak Beynon) and the Cherry & Whites (team manager Tony Trumper). Ponty Daff's played in the women's competition. One squad, one passion!
The tournament was proudly sponsored by Clearsafe Knotweed & Bamboo.
